Subjects included six healthy non-smokers, eight smokers with small airway disease and chronic simple bronchitis, and eight subjects with chronic obstructive bronchitis. literature.title: The role of N-acetylcysteine in the management of acute and chronic pulmonary complications of sulfur mustard: a literature review.
literature.abstract: Sulfur mustard exposure, as the most widely used chemical weapon, can lead to acute and long-term pulmonary complications via various pathways, such as triggering an imbalance between the oxidant and antioxidant system. Currently, there is no validated antidote, chemoprophylaxis and curative modality for pulmonary toxicities secondary to sulfur mustard exposure.

literature.title: Tracheal Aspirate Levels of the Matricellular Protein SPARC Predict Development of Bronchopulmonary Dysplasia.
literature.abstract: Isolation of tracheal aspirate mesenchymal stromal cells (MSCs) from premature infants has been associated with increased risk of bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD). MSCs show high levels of mRNAs encoding matricellular proteins, non-structural extracellular proteins that regulate cell-matrix interactions and participate in tissue remodeling. We hypothesized that lung matricellular protein expression predicts BPD development.

literature.title: Protective Effects of N-Acetylcysteine on Lipopolysaccharide-Induced Respiratory Inflammation and Oxidative Stress.
literature.abstract: As the leading cause of bovine respiratory disease (BRD), bacterial pneumonia can result in tremendous losses in the herd farming industry worldwide. N-acetylcysteine (NAC), an acetylated precursor of the amino acid L-cysteine, has been reported to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. To explore the protective effect and underlying mechanisms of NAC in ALI, we investigated its role in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced bovine embryo tracheal cells (EBTr) and mouse lung injury models.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: NAC（乙醯半胱氨酸）作為氣道黏液溶解劑擁有完整的臨床轉化鏈：(1) 硫基直接斷裂黏液醣蛋白二硫鍵，降低痰液黏彈性（PMID 10576438）；(2) 促進纖毛擺動，改善黏液纖毛清除效率（PMID 23113953）；(3) 抑制 NLRP3 炎症體活化，減少氣道炎症（PMID 36498845）；(4) 在機械通氣 ICU 患者（950名）中霧化給藥研究已完成（NCT02159196）。L-Cysteine 本身具相同硫基且為 NAC 前驅物，藥理轉化合理，但需注意 NAC 在多國已有核准適應症，獨立開發 L-Cysteine 的差異化定位需進一步釐清。
鼻淚管疾病（阻塞、狹窄、炎症）的標準治療為淚道探通術或手術重建。Cysteine 的黏液溶解機制理論上可能緩解因黏液栓或炎症性滲出物造成的輕度功能性鼻淚管阻塞，但此假設完全缺乏臨床文獻支持（0篇文獻，0項試驗）。與 'excretory apparatus of the lacrimal system anomaly' 相似，為計算預測誤判，建議不進入後續評估。
